wwo.name: Cairo
wwo.method: The c.1895 plan supplies street axes, built block perimeters, open ground, archaeological margins and water. The 1900 Ministry plan corroborates the Nile, Qasr al-Nil Bridge, Ismailia Canal and western extension. Revision 2 traces the ordinary Gamaliya lanes, both sides of the western river approach and the southern Citadel-to-Qarafa connection. Individual ordinary buildings remain typological inferences within demonstrated blocks. All geometry uses the existing single city-plan-scale fit.

registration.reference: One WGS84 azimuthal equidistant frame for all geometry. Similarity fit in half-resolution working pixels relative to the 1920 × 2314 BnF reproduction. Present reference points register the period sheet only. Actual historical footprint edge precision is lower than the numeric coordinate format.
